scope: P03 generic SMTP claim and uncertain-outcome barrier; source and sandbox only

source_integrity.scope: intentional changes only to generic execution route and owner startup reconciliation; repaired intake and project guard retained

demonstrated_defect: Generic SMTP action remained APPROVED_FOR_EXECUTION while awaiting the provider; concurrent requests or timeout/restart could send the same action again. Partial acceptance was incorrectly marked executed, and a failed final save left approval on disk.
changes: one durable execution claim plus audit BEFORE sendMail; failed claim save rolls back and never invokes transport
per-action claim stores attempt ID, exact payload/type/target snapshot hash and predetermined Message-ID for future reconciliation; Message-ID is not a provider deduplication guarantee
full provider-reported acceptance recorded as accepted_by_smtp with delivery_verified=false
timeouts, rejection/partial/pending results and failed settlement never restore execution eligibility; no automatic retry
owner startup marks interrupted SMTP claims UNCERTAIN; readers, readonly mode and restore quarantine do not mutate them
superseding draft cancellation leaves claimed SMTP attempts unchanged; Peu-specific SQLite effect ledger and authorization flow unchanged
generic SMTP timeouts bounded consistently with existing Peu transport settings
retain available partial SMTP response evidence in private state for later reconciliation, without treating it as delivery or automatic-retry permission

tests.http_transport: nodemailer.createTransport stub only; synthetic example.invalid recipient; no SMTP connection
tests.actual_startup: separate Node processes import the real server on ephemeral localhost; provider fetch and SMTP constructors fail if called

live_readonly.scope: fresh deployment/service metadata only; no new memory, backup or live restart tests

limitations: single owning process/store assumption; no multi-process lock or fsync/power-loss guarantee

no live checkpoint/restart/OOM or end-to-end acceptance
